$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, for editors.

name.description: The deployment's name, as CDK's stack name prefix: every physical name derives from it.

tags.description: Tags, as CDK Tags, on every stack of both CDK apps; the AgentCore project also carries agentcore:project-name.

names.description: Physical names that differ from the derived ones, each by its role and CloudFormation name property.

env.description: Where the deployment runs, as CDK Environment.

webAliases.description: Further origins the web UI is served at, as Copilot's http.alias: CORS allows web and these.

chatService.description: The Chat Service's origin; its hostname, over https, issues the per-Turn JWT.

chatServicePreview.description: BotCube-owned: the preview origin's Chat Service, which a deploy verifies before production moves to it.

credentialService.description: The Credential Service's public origin, which the product's own pages call; absent, it is private.

productService.description: The product's own service, which the Credential Service also serves at this origin; needs credentialService.

domains.description: Where the deployment is reached, each a web origin.

allowCommandCredentials.description: Whether a credential may come from a command, which then runs as the service; whoever can edit this file chooses that command.

caBundle.description: A PEM file of the roots every process checks the proxy and endpoints against, as SSL_CERT_FILE, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE; loaded at startup. Absent, each image keeps its own.

issuer.description: The provider's issuer URL, where its OpenID configuration is discovered.

secretId.description: As Secrets Manager GetSecretValue's SecretId: the secret's name, in the reader's own account and region, or its ARN.

oneOf.description: A Secrets Manager secret's string, read with the process's own AWS credentials.

path.description: A file the platform mounts, such as a secret injector writes; read again as it rotates.

oneOf.description: A mounted file's contents, a trailing newline dropped.

command.description: The program and its arguments, run without a shell.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long the command may run before it is stopped.

oneOf.description: A command printing a Kubernetes ExecCredential (status.token, status.expirationTimestamp) on stdout, run again before the token expires; its stderr is discarded. Runs only under allowCommandCredentials.

tokenEndpoint.description: The identity provider's token endpoint, as its OpenID configuration names token_endpoint.

Outbound traffic goes direct.

services.description: The services BotCube creates, where one serves differently from its default.

image.description: As ECS ContainerDefinition.Image: the Chat Service image, pinned by digest in production. Absent, BotCube builds the bot's own Chat Service, or its stock one.

As ECS ContainerDefinition.Image and Lambda Code.ImageUri, so an Amazon ECR image: the Credential Service image, which its audit-copy Lambda also runs, pinned by digest in production. Absent, BotCube builds the bot's own Credential Service, or its stock one.

path.description: BotCube-owned: the prefix the Credential Service serves its RPC under, which its listener rule and the service read alike; absent, none.

publicPaths.description: BotCube-owned: the paths under path the User's browser may reach at domains.credentialService; required with it.

leadingKeyPrefixes.description: As DynamoDB's dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition: the partition-key prefixes of the Chat table rows the product's service reads and writes.

platformVersion.description: BotCube-owned: the Runtime's platform generation; absent, V2.

containerUri.description: As CloudFormation Runtime ContainerConfiguration.ContainerUri: the Bot Image the Runtime runs, built FROM the Harness image and pinned by digest in production. Required when deploying an AgentCore Runtime; build and publish the Bot Image before synthesis.

maxLifetime.description: As LifecycleConfiguration.maxLifetime, in seconds; absent, 3600. Capped by ADR 0029.

rollbackEndpoint.description: BotCube-owned: a V1_ROLLBACK endpoint on an earlier Runtime version, to move back to; absent, none.

extension.description: The link browser's extension, as CloudFormation's S3Location.

natGateways.description: As CDK VpcProps.natGateways: 1, BotCube creates and parks a NAT in existing.vpc; 0 or absent, the VPC brings its own egress.

publicIp.description: As AWS::EC2::EIP PublicIp: the Elastic IP BotCube's NAT egress leaves through, which the egress stack owns once imported; with natGateways 1.

openEgress.description: Where the agent's commands and the Agent Computer's Chromium reach every destination but loopback, which no Endpoint names.

proxy.description: Reached through the forward proxy at integrations.proxy; absent, direct.

cloudflare.description: The Cloudflare records BotCube creates in front of the origins.

zone.description: BotCube-owned: the Cloudflare zone the origins are records in.

caCertificate.description: The authenticated origin-pull CA bundle, as ElasticLoadBalancingV2 TrustStore S3 bucket, key and optional object version.

organization.description: BotCube-owned: the Organization (O) of the origin pull client certificate's subject; absent, name.

oneOf.description: The Chat Service polls its own table and sends each due run to the run queue.
No scheduled tasks: the Chat Service offers none, and no queue, schedule group or scheduler grant is created.
The Agent Computer's browser streams its live view from AgentCore Browser to the User.
No live view: bot settings may not turn agentComputer.liveBrowser on, and the Chat Service is granted no live view stream.

availabilityZone.description: As CDK SubnetAttributes.availabilityZone, which CDK needs to synthesize without credentials.

publicSubnets.description: The origin load balancer's subnets; with network.natGateways 1, the NAT is in the first.

availabilityZone.description: As CDK SubnetAttributes.availabilityZone, which CDK needs to synthesize without credentials.

ipv4CidrBlock.description: As CDK SubnetAttributes.ipv4CidrBlock, which CDK needs to synthesize without credentials.

routeTableId.description: As CDK SubnetAttributes.routeTableId: required with network.natGateways 1, which routes it to the NAT.

privateSubnets.description: The services', browsers' and Lambdas' subnets.

vpc.description: The VPC, as CDK VpcAttributes: BotCube creates none. With network.natGateways 0 or absent, its private subnets must already reach the internet.

link.description: The link browser, in existing.vpc's private subnets, and its security group.

sheet.description: Decrypts what the Sign-in Sheet encrypts: the alias of an RSA ENCRYPT_DECRYPT key, which the Credential Service checks at startup. Rotate it by creating a new RSA key and moving the alias: no redeploy, and a sheet open across the move is re-opened. Only a Credential Service that mounts the Sign-in Sheet routes uses it.

functions.description: Encrypts the Credential Service's audit-copy Lambda's environment in place of the AWS managed key.

streamArn.description: The table's NEW_IMAGE stream, which parking reads.

vault.description: The Credential Service's vault: partition key accountId, sort key provider.

connectionLogs.description: The origin load balancer's connection logs.

slots.description: As CDK BucketAttributes: the bucket parking keeps the origin's slot in.

fileSystemId.description: The Files file system, with a mount target in each existing private subnet.

kmsKey.description: The key the file system is encrypted with.

accountsAccessPointId.description: The Chat Service's access point: root directory /accounts, as uid and gid 1000.

accessPoints.description: The pool each User's access point is leased from on their first Files use, each as uid and gid 1000; none free, Files fail naming this field.

files.description: The Files file system and the access points Users lease from it: BotCube creates neither, and no access point at runtime. Each Turn mounts Files by the mount target's address, which the deploy reads from EFS. ECS mounts the Chat Service's own volume by <fileSystemId>.efs.<region>.amazonaws.com, so the VPC's resolver must answer that name.

credentialService.description: A Credential Service Endpoint, for a network that refuses a private DNS namespace: BotCube creates no Cloud Map namespace or service.

url.description: The URL the Chat Service and the Harness call the Credential Service at, such as a DNS name in front of the target group; it authenticates them with its own invocation token.

targetGroupArn.description: The IP target group in front of that URL, which BotCube registers the Credential Service's tasks into.

securityGroupId.description: The security group of the load balancer in front of that target group: BotCube admits it to the Credential Service's port.

existing.description: Resources the operator supplies, with their grants, instead of BotCube creating them: BotCube creates neither a existing resource nor a policy on it, and `botcube footprint` lists the grants each one needs. Each one left out, BotCube creates and grants.

planUsage.description: BotCube-owned: Plan Usage, whose models run on a linked plan.

ownerAccountId.description: The Account whose linked plans they run on.

parking.description: Parking, which stops an idle deployment and wakes it on a request.

automationUserAgents.description: BotCube-owned: User-Agent substrings marking automation, which doesn't wake a parked deployment.

autoPark.description: BotCube-owned: whether an idle deployment parks itself; absent, it does not.

alarms.description: The alarms BotCube creates beside its default ones.

runtime.description: BotCube-owned: alarms on the Runtime's errors, to the alerts topic; absent, none.

metricNamespace.description: As CloudWatch MetricTransformation.MetricNamespace: the Runtime's log-error metric.

x-renamed-keys.bot: /bot/bot.yaml in the Bot Image; remove bot
x-renamed-keys.productName: productName in /bot/bot.yaml, the Bot Image's bot settings
x-renamed-keys.productService: productService in /bot/bot.yaml, the Bot Image's bot settings
x-renamed-keys.integrations.proxy.noProxy: proxy: integrations.proxy on each endpoint the proxy carries; every other destination goes direct
x-renamed-keys.integrations.modelGateway.wire: each model's provider in /bot/bot.yaml, anthropic or openai
x-renamed-keys.integrations.modelGateway.cacheMarkers: each Claude model's provider anthropic in /bot/bot.yaml, whose calls carry cache markers
x-renamed-keys.**.secretArn: secretId, the secret's name or ARN
